Qatar’s LNG Expansion to Fuel the Global Transition

Qatar is rapidly expanding its annual LNG production capacity from 77 million (metric) tones (MT) in 2024 to 142 MT by 2030—an 85 percent increase.3 This growth is designed to establish Qatar as a leading player in the global LNG market, with the potential to control nearly 25 percent of the market by the decade’s end.
